_doc: Running on the street map: hold Shift (ui/game/gameLoop.js → InnerMap._runHeld; world/innerMap/movement.js). runPace: how much faster than a walk. Each tile run on foot costs energyPerTile energy (cut by the Endurance perk, player/endurance.js) and earns xpPerTile Endurance XP; riding costs you nothing. Below windedBelow energy you are winded and can only walk until you are back above recoverAbove.
